sections.label: Your Toxic Attraction:
sections.text: You attract people who fall for your softness and then test how much of it they can take. They love your tenderness until it asks something of them. You keep choosing people who are deep on paper and gone in practice. Your heart writes love stories. Your taste keeps casting people who leave before the ending. You give them a home. They treat it like a hotel.

sections.label: What You Really Need:
sections.text: Someone who chooses you out loud and keeps choosing you. A partner who is present, not just poetic. You need love that shows up, not love you have to decode. Someone who matches your gentleness without using it. You do not need a mystery. You need a person who stays when the softness gets real.
